inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The printed full-page flowchart: entry at the Ghon complex (Ghon focus usually mid/lower lobes + hilar nodes, with a '+' glyph) → Primary tuberculosis, splitting >90% (Healing by fibrosis, Calcification [PPD ⊕]) vs <10% (Progressive primary tuberculosis [AIDS, malnutrition]); the healing road continues to Reactivation → 2° tuberculosis (Fibrocaseous cavitary lesion, usually upper lobes) → Localized destructive disease (Cavity, Caseation, Scar); the progressive road splits to Progressive lung disease and Bacteremia → Miliary tuberculosis with a body silhouette labeling Meninges, Vertebrae (Pott disease), Joints and long bones, Lymph nodes, Lungs, Liver, Spleen, Adrenal gland. Pure vector (pdfimages empty at the diagram region).
